This '''individual''' was the [[Marriage/Legends|husband]] of [[Clarani]], a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Ryn/Legends|Ryn]]. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], he [[Death/Legends|died]] during the evacuation of the [[Jubilee Wheel (space station)|Jubilee Wheel]].<ref name="BP" /> By [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The New Jedi Order: Balance Point]]'' to [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]].</ref> Clarani was living as a [[Refugee/Legends|refugee]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Duro/Legends|Duro]].<ref name="BP" />
